payload.description: shape defined by (type, action); element commits carry the overview §4.3 element object

OPEN_CANVAS.description: dual dialect, discriminated by the presence of the 'canvas' key (exactly one dialect per message)

canvas.description: complete Doc 03 CanvasDocumentModel document.json body (snake_case wire keys): canvas_id, title, created_at, updated_at, artboard, content_bounds, elements[...] — the receiver MUST load it as the currently-open document (replace scene/canvas state) and switch its UI to it

path.description: filesystem path of a PC-local .slatesync file — MUST NEVER be sent over the wire; CanvasSyncManager (PC) ignores OPEN_CANVAS payloads lacking 'canvas', and the tablet never sends this dialect

CANVAS_LIST_REQUEST.description: request the tablet's canvas list (empty payload)

canvases.description: may be EMPTY; sorted updated_at DESC; pushed unsolicited on (re)connect and after create/rename/delete, and sent in reply to CANVAS_LIST_REQUEST

CANVAS_OPEN_REQUEST.description: asks the tablet to load that document, switch its own UI to it, and broadcast OPEN_CANVAS {canvas: <full doc>}

canvas.description: complete Doc 03 CanvasDocumentModel document.json body (snake_case wire keys)

CANVAS_PUT.description: persist silently, NO UI switch: receiver stores locally first, then refreshes its list. LWW: apply only if canvas.updated_at >= local.updated_at (equal => keep local, no churn)

CANVAS_PULL.description: receiver replies CANVAS_PUT only if its stored copy has updated_at > have_updated_at

CLEAR_CANVAS.description: EMPTY payload {} (Doc 02 §10.1) — the target document is the envelope's canvas_id; the receiver wipes ALL elements of its open document (artboard/background/title preserved), bumps updated_at, persists (LWW), refreshes lists

asset_upload.abort_semantics: only ASSET_DONE finalizes a transfer_id; an aborted transfer is never applied (partial data discarded)

export_job.dpi_note: required for PNG/JPG; PDF is vector and ignores dpi

progress.rate: <= 10 Hz plus one message per rendered strip
